author: LadyLeigh
name: TwitchBridge
short: Twitch connections, shared commands, announcements and chat logs.
description: Custom Twitch/Discord bridge with command-free persistent linking panels, verified member accounts, per-broadcaster roles, shoutouts, shared commands, native announcements and chat logs.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server Discord/Twitch identity links and timestamps, broadcaster and bot OAuth tokens, channel/role settings and integration-owned role grants. Pending verification codes and cooldowns are in memory. Supports member unlink and Red data deletion. Existing mirrored Discord chat logs have independent retention. Stores linking-panel message IDs and configuration. Identity-only member approval tokens are transient, revoked after use, and never saved.
